Lumen envía el token humano, el token de: Lumen sends the human token, the agent token and the RAR for the operation. Verify returns a signed OBO JWT: sub identifies the human and actor-token.sub identifies the agent.
Lumen presents the JWT in X-Vault-Token. Vault validates its signature, issuer and validity; the OAuth profile uses user_claim=sub and actor_claim=actor-token.sub. Aliases resolve the human and agent separately.
Vault obtiene las políticas humanas, sus: Vault obtains the human policies, replaces identity.entity.id with the human UUID, and also checks the agent ceiling and RAR.
Política humana ∩ techo del agente ∩ RAR: Human policy ∩ agent ceiling ∩ token RAR

The path is within the user’s own space. This does not guarantee access: the Read and Reveal agents, for example, cannot write because of their ceilings.
La política personal mostrada no permite: The personal policy shown does not allow this other user’s path. Changing the URL or requesting that path in RAR does not change the human identity resolved from the token.
Este paso corresponde a Verify. Su HTTP: This step is a Verify call. Its HTTP 200 does not prove secret access; select the Vault call.
Vault ha denegado esta operación. La com: Vault denied this operation. The path comparison explains isolation; HTTP 403 alone does not identify every rule involved.
Vault ha permitido una ruta ajena. Revis: Vault allowed another user’s path. Review other policies or configuration changes; the personal policy shown does not explain this permission.
Vault ha permitido esta operación. Ademá: Vault allowed this operation. In addition to the own-space path, the agent ceiling and RAR had to allow it.
Este resultado no confirma acceso ni ais: This result confirms neither access nor isolation: it may be a missing secret, a version conflict or another error. Inspect the actual response.
Por qué hay un wildcard en el Registry: Why the Registry contains a wildcard
El mismo agente atiende a varios usuario: The same agent serves multiple users. Its ceiling may cover lumen-personal/*, but each user only has lumen-personal/THEIR_UUID/*. OBO requires the intersection; the agent wildcard does not grant access to everyone’s spaces.
La política lumen-personal-user llega al: The human inherits lumen-personal-user through the lumen-personal-users group. Registry policies limit the agent. RAR narrows the specific operation; it expands neither of the other layers.

No registrado en este paso. Selecciona e: Not recorded in this step. Select the OBO exchange or Vault request to inspect its RAR.
Origen de los datos y cómo comprobarlo: Data provenance and how to verify it
Los nombres, UUID y snapshots HCL proced: Names, UUIDs and HCL snapshots come from the catalogue published by the installer and recorded by Lumen in this execution. The expanded template explains that configuration; it is not a read of Vault’s effective ACL.
La respuesta HTTP de la llamada a Vault: The Vault call’s HTTP response records the observed outcome. To inspect the full token and request, use View sensitive values or Open request workbench on that step. Older traces leave unrecorded fields empty.
Puedes comprobar el vínculo en Vault: pe: Check the binding in Vault: OAuth profile verify, the human entity alias, group lumen-personal-users and policy lumen-personal-user. The alias must link issuer + external_id to the human canonical_id.
